doc.price: Current selling price after coupon deduction. (USD)
doc.title: Product title.
doc.a_plus: Whether the product has A+ content.
doc.coupon: Coupon discount amount. Positive value = amount(local currency), negative = percentage discount.Value -1: no data for that period.
doc.profit: Estimated product gross profit. (USD).Value -1: no data for that period.
doc.fba_fee: FBA fulfillment fee. (USD).Value -1: no data for that period.
doc.category: Primary category object {name, node_id}. (Array structure: [category name, node_id])
doc.has_video: Whether the product has main image video.
doc.seller_id: Buybox seller ID, can be used for shop_request to query store details. Returns null when Buybox is Amazon itself.
doc.ship_cost: FBM delivery cost. (USD).Value -1: no data for that period.
doc.sub_title: Product subtitle; null if not exists.
doc.parent_asin: Parent ASIN; null if no variation parent.
doc.peak_season: Peak season months, e.g. "11月"; null if no obvious peak season. (Return "均衡" if there is no obvious peak season)
doc.seller_name: Buybox seller name, not brand store name.
doc.listing_date: Amazon listing date, different from Sorftime collected date, format yyyy-MM-dd.
doc.platform_fee: Amazon platform commission fee. (USD).Value -1: no data for that period.
doc.seller_count: Total seller count for this listing.
doc.sub_category: Sub category object {name, node_id, rank}. (2D array: [[category name, node_id, rank, date yyyyMMdd]])
doc.extra_savings: Array of related promotion info; empty array if no promotion.
doc.seller_country: Buybox seller country/region 2-letter code such as CN/US; null for Amazon own.
doc.has_brand_store: Whether the brand has brand store.
doc.yearly_sales_volume: Estimated yearly sales volume.Value -1: no data for that period.
doc.monthly_sales_amount: Estimated monthly sales amount. (USD).Value -1: no data for that period.
doc.monthly_sales_volume: Estimated monthly sales volume.Value -1: no data for that period.
